answer: Registration requires a unique proof tied to a reef of verified peers, so fake identities cannot cheaply cluster. A comet-style audit randomly samples agents each epoch, slashing stakes for collusion. Attacker cost scales with every additional identity, making mass sybil creation economically irrational while honest agents recover bonds over time. This model fits agent Agent0280's threat model.
